clauses.clause: Scripted infected keep normal perception: within aggro range they engage the player, companions and survivors, in every level. PO: "even when they walk somewhere, they should still act like Zombies".
clauses.note: Fresh controlled production-world matrix:520 human scripted player/escort contacts across every level/quality plus64 animal contacts in L8/L10;584/584 scripts interrupt for nearby human targets, no setup errors. The separate540-case finite-focus/companion matrix rechecks every human role:278 supported escort cases acquire the nearby escort, including prior L3/L4/L6/L8 focus failures. Two L9 rush calls have no L1 brain and do not establish a supported rush setup; direct scripted and focus contacts cover L9 separately. Support-role approach/attention is distinguished from a damaging strike (screamers/nurses need not emit a normal attack). All260 companion samples retain100 HP; the corgi is immune/non-prey under G-19. No AI, perception, director count or timers are changed after disclosed fixture setup.
